evals.prompt: We're starting a small B2B invoicing product for freelancers and small agencies: they create invoices, send them to clients, get paid by card or bank transfer, and chase late payers. Solo developer, one or two deployables at most. Start the DDD process on it — auto mode, don't ask me anything.
evals.expected_output: Announces ddd-understand (1/8) in auto mode with an inferred depth (light) and prints the absolute workspace path. Runs ddd init from the project root with --dir ddd, a kebab-case --project slug, --mode auto, --depth light, --deployables-min 1 --deployables-max 2 --teams 1. Writes ddd/01-understand/understand.md (ten H2 sections from the template) and ddd/01-understand/understand.json with: system.lifecycle 'greenfield'; at least one goal with metric, target and horizon (e.g. time-to-first-invoice or paid-within-N-days); actors with kebab-case ids, 'freelancer' first as primary, plus at least one obstructing/secondary actor such as 'client' or 'tax-authority'; impacts phrased as behaviour changes referencing existing actors and goals; deliverables referencing impacts with must/should/could; 3–8 capabilities named as noun phrases (Invoicing, Card payments, Bank transfer reconciliation, Dunning/late-payment follow-up …) each with an evolution stage where card payments is 'commodity'; at least one constraint (e.g. regulatory: e-invoicing/tax rules, or PCI) and one non-goal; existing_systems present (e.g. Stripe, will: integrate); scale_target 1–2 deployables, 1 team. Assumptions[] and non-blocking open_questions[] are populated (no AskUserQuestion calls). Runs ddd understand lint and ddd validate --step understand with zero errors, marks the step done via ddd mark, and closes with absolute paths, 3–6 findings, the open questions and '/ddd-discover' as the next step. Contains no service/database/endpoint design.

evals.prompt: Kick off domain modelling for this repo. It's our existing Django monolith for managing gym memberships (see README.md and the apps/ folder). We want to design the next version properly before we split anything out. Ask me what you need.
evals.expected_output: Runs in interactive mode. Reads README.md, the apps/ module names, docs and any docker-compose/k8s files before asking anything, then posts an inputs-check message stating the resolved mode, inferred depth (standard), lifecycle 'brownfield' or 'rewrite', and a scale target inferred from the repo or asked for as a multiple-choice question (1–3 / 4–9 / 10–20 deployables) together with the project name/one-liner only if they are not in the README. Drafts the whole artifact first, then presents it in sections (system + canvas; goals + impact map; capabilities + evolution; constraints, non-goals, existing systems, scale target) with at most four targeted questions per section via AskUserQuestion — about goal metrics, missing actors, capability boundaries and evolution stages, never about formatting. Records the Django monolith and any integrations (payments, access-control hardware, email) in existing_systems with will replace/integrate/ignore, uses the repo's existing vocabulary for actor and capability names, and gives a final confirmation listing assumptions, open questions and the file paths before writing. Runs ddd init from the project root, writes understand.md and understand.json, passes ddd understand lint and ddd validate, marks the step done (draft if the user stopped early), and names /ddd-discover as the next step.

evals.prompt: You are running as step 1 of ddd-workflow. Workspace: ./ddd. Mode: auto. Depth: light. Scale target: 1–3 deployables, 1 team. Project: the meal-kit subscription service described in README.md. Produce the understand artifacts and stop.
evals.expected_output: Asks no questions. Uses exactly the passed workspace, mode, depth and scale target: ddd init run from the project root with --dir ddd --mode auto --depth light --deployables-min 1 --deployables-max 3 --teams 1 --source README.md. Output is sized to light depth: one-line BMC cells, 1–2 goals with metrics, an impact map for the primary actor (subscriber) only, 3–8 noun-phrase capabilities each with an evolution stage (e.g. subscription management 'product', menu planning 'custom', fulfilment 'custom', payments 'commodity'), at least one constraint and one non-goal, existing_systems present, scale_target 1–3/1. Does not print the three checkpoints as separate messages; folds them (inputs read; mode/depth/scale/lifecycle and why; assumptions and questions recorded) into the closing summary. ddd understand lint and ddd validate --step understand report zero errors; ddd mark sets understand to done with --mode auto and the two artifact paths (draft only if a blocking open question exists — none expected). Ends with a short summary containing the absolute artifact paths, key findings, open questions, the validator result and 'next: ddd-discover', without starting the discover step.
